title: Author blocks a GitHub account and unblocks it from a Blocked users page: its comments leave public view everywhere, it can no longer comment, send feedback or vote, and its vote stays as it was
how_to_read: Each attempt is one line and a `details` filename in this same directory. Open a detail file ONLY when this index points you at one -- the summaries are here so you do not have to. `caused_by` is what sent the stage back; `changed` is what the attempt then touched, counted by kind. Several attempts in a row that were caused by the same stage and changed no `src` is a loop, not progress.

open.issue: C1 The author blocks a GitHub account (POST /admin/users/{u}/block, writing blocked_accounts through internal/comments): missing
C2 A blocked account can no longer comment or reply (refused, stored nowhere): missing
C3 A blocked account can no longer send feedback: missing
C4 A blocked account can no longer like or dislike, and cannot change or withdraw its vote (vote frozen): missing
C5 Blocking changes no vote numbers: a blocked account's likes and dislikes keep counting: partial

C7 Blocked users page (SC-022): lists each blocked account with every comment it posted (its report and, for a reply, the parent comment), removed ones without text, its feedback, and an Unblock control. Reached from an admin link: missing
C8 Unblocking from the Blocked users page restores the account's comments and counts publicly and lets it take part again (a comment removed while blocked stays hidden): missing
C9 The account's feedback is marked 'blocked' on the report's admin view, only for blocked senders, and Block controls exist on the admin moderation list: missing

No screens are declared. The Blocked users page and the admin report page sit behind GitHub sign-in, and config refuses to start without HBAND_* variables (lesson #961), so the engine cannot open them with a bare command. They were rendered and read through the real binary over HTTP instead, but not in a real browser (m9 was deferred by a person).
Not built, as decided: a Block entry point on feedback articles (m8), a size bound on the Blocked users page (m10), and a census of public write routes (m7). All three were deferred by decision.

Architecture globs: C-009 should own internal/server/templates/admin_blocked.html and admin_report.html, and C-005 or C-009 the new server tests (block_test.go, unblock_test.go). I could not file this as a paths edit because the record edits are capped at three.
tests/acceptance/check_e006_1_stops_at_block.py is scaffolding that now reports 'passes outright'. Lesson #976 says it should go; its own docstring says it need not, so I left it.

A blocked reader is still shown the comment, vote and feedback forms (reader pages must stay byte-identical, #950) and gets a bare 403 text page when it presses one. Decide whether a friendlier notice is wanted.

A signed-in Chrome render of /admin/blocked and the moderation list (m9), and the owner-page size bound (m10): /admin/blocked also does one feedback query per account and one thread read per published report with replies.
Run the engine's Fitness op=check on .taad/fitness.yaml; I had no such tool and relied on go test ./internal/fitnessrules plus a manual single-quote count.

deviation: Block's owner refusal is in the store, not in the handler as design 229 said: comments.New takes the owner id, Block returns ErrOwnerBlock and fails closed when no owner is pinned (decided findings m2 and its critic note). The handler only maps ErrOwnerBlock to 400.
deviation: Each Book (comments, votes, feedback) has an unexported isBlocked seam so the follow-up-read failure can be tested (finding m3's critic note). The design had a plain read.

deviation: The Blocked users page builds parent links through a.tree, Find and branchRoot, one read per published report that has a reply on the page, and prints 'in reply to a hidden comment' as text when the parent is drawn nowhere (finding m5's critic note). The design used a fixed /reports/<slug>#comment-<parent>.

deviation: A blocked account's feedback is listed with a link to /admin/reports/<slug>#feedback-<id>, where the author reads and answers it, rather than the reader page. SenderMessage and BlockedComment also carry Published, which the design's types lacked, so an unpublished report links to its admin page.

deviation: Block and unblock take no field, and their handlers never read the body (lesson #973's 'decided choice to ignore the body'). They are classified 'no field' in TestPostRoutesAreClassified, and TestBlock sends every removeBodyRows shape to both.

deviation: from=blocked is checked first in adminCommentRemove, so it lands on /admin/blocked for drafts and unpublished reports too (M1's critic note). bodyRow's landing went from a bool to a string.

deviation: The comments-package tests are named TestBlockStore, TestPostRefusesBlocked and so on, not TestBlock, because TestBlock names the server route test in the design. No workaround for an outside defect was needed, so there is no setting or notice.
